title: ML-guided FeCoCrMnCu hydroxide for oxygen evolution
summary: An XGBoost model trained on measurements from 70 Fe–Co–Cr–Mn–Cu compositions selected a layered double hydroxide for oxygen evolution. The reported composition had a measured overpotential of 270 mV at 10 mA cm⁻², versus a model prediction of 261.3 mV; the paper also reports a 72-hour stability test under its protocol. This comparison does not establish universal catalyst superiority or full-cell performance.

evidence.tested: Publisher supporting information and indexed abstract identify the optimal Fe0.15Co0.10Cr0.30Mn0.30Cu0.15 composition, experimentally measured 270 mV overpotential, and 72 h operation.
evidence.unknown: Independent replication and broader application are not established by this bounded review.
evidence.ai_role: XGBoost trained on 70 experimental compositions guides selection from a much larger composition space; researchers synthesize and characterize the selected catalyst.

source_review.scope: Publisher indexed article abstract and publisher-hosted supporting information; source identity/DOI and results checked. Full article text not accessed.
